fact: The Customs Authority head said the customs development plan rests on full digital transformation through the Nafeza platform, with work on Advance Cargo Information for sea imports, wider risk management and an AI-based automated tariff classification and valuation system.
title: رئيس "الجمارك": تطوير نظام التسجيل المسبق للشحنات «ACI» للواردات البحرية
